articleTitle: Extended VIKOR for multi-criteria decision making problems under intuitionistic environment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The VIKOR method was developed for multi-criteria optimization of complex systems. This method focuses on ranking and selecting from a set of alternatives in the presence of conflicting criteria. It introduces the multi-criteria ranking index based on the particular measure of “closeness” to the “ideal” solution. The aim of this paper is to extend the VIKOR method for decision making problems with ratings of alternatives being expressed using intuitionistic fuzzy sets and criteria weights is completely unknown. To determine the weights with respect to a set of criteria represented by intuitionistic fuzzy sets, we establish an entropy weight model, which can be used to get the criteria weights. Furthermore, a novel nonlinear normalization technique is adapted to modify the VIKOR. Finally, a compared numerical example illustrates and clarifies the main results developed in this paper.

articleTitle: The analysis of state-owned assets management under mutual trust mechanism based on system dynamics model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, the mutual trust mechanism between government and state-owned enterprises (SOEs) is divided into three modes (Plan-Control, Guide-Coordinate, Supervise-Serve), in accordance with three different types of government-enterprise relationships. These types of relationships are identified according to the organizational form of SOEs in China as well as the present situation of relationships between government and SOEs. From the basic content of mutual trust mechanism, we apply Systems Dynamics (SD) model to simulate these three modes' and traditional state-owned assets operation under different market conditions. It indicates that Plan-Control mutual trust mechanism plays a better role when market demand is stable, while Guide-Coordinate mutual trust mechanism is more adaptable to demand disturbance. Besides changes in market demand, the internal structure of the system also has some influence on state-owned assets management under mutual trust mechanism.

articleTitle: Application of factor analysis and fuzzy c-means for classification of knowledge intensity in China's manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper introduces an application of factor analysis for illuminating the distinct dimensions of manufacturing's knowledge intensity which then gives help to industry classification with fuzzy c-means. With the world now coming into an age called “knowledge economy”, it is necessary to analyze the industry level and knowledge-intensity in different industries, furthermore, analyze how those reflect the industrial structure and ultimately the entire economy. With respect to knowledge-based innovation theory, principle component analysis is to be used, while a number of possibly correlated knowledge measures are transformed into a smaller number which can be used to identify different industries with different knowledge intensity. The data from China's manufacturing industries in recent 5 years shows the developing paths of those industries. The empirical results show that although knowledge-intensity-based classification of China's manufacturing industry is similar to those of foreign countries, many industries are much less developed and even lagged far behind. China's industrial structure still needs to be perfected.

articleTitle: Research on slotting optimization in automated warehouse of pharmaceutical logistics center
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the automated warehouse storage management process, due to changes in internal and external environment, the cargo space in the warehouse will become inappropriate and will have to be re-allocated to improve cargo management efficiency and reduce storage management costs. In view of the storage characteristics of pharmaceutical products and the characteristics of automated warehouse, in order to improve the efficiency of the goods moving into and out of the warehouse, store related products together, decrease transportation time of moving products, this paper puts forth a multi objective model, uses genetic algorithms to solve the model, and uses a simulation example to prove the model. The result shows that storage mode can, basically, satisfy the three objectives and achieve slotting optimization.

articleTitle: Is cronyism always negative? A model of organizational appointment based on structure of guanxi
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper explores the trait of superiors behavior in appointing subordinate and examines the rationality of cronyism from a new angle of view. Focusing on the exploration of the origin of cronyism, potential objects of organizational appointment are divided into four parts: person with loyalty guanxi, person with little guanxi, person with geo-likeness guanxi, and person with blood guanxi. What kind of subordinate would be appointed more depends on the superiors' value rules and a loyalty guanxi between them is principal. Then a model of organizational appointment from a perspective of structure of guanxi is proposed. Especially, this paper analyzes the wrapping effect of organizational culture (value) against superiors' value in organizational appointment. This study is useful for organization member to understand the phenomenon of organizational appointment well and promoting positive organizational behavior in organizations.

articleTitle: The game analysis on interests distribution of industry-university-research cooperative technology innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The distribution of interests is a key part of the process of IUR cooperative technology innovation, and there are some potential conflicts between the main subjects of cooperative innovation. This paper firstly analyzes the main interest conflicts among the subjects of IUR cooperative technology innovation; secondly it constructs a dynamic game model of industry, UR and government; then it makes a general equilibrium analysis; at last it gives some enlightenment of the distribution of benefits.

articleTitle: Online advertising channel choice — Posted price vs. auction
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Online advertising plays more important role in 21st century. Scholars pay much attention on how to bid in sponsored search auction. While few research have been done on advertisers facing mixed pricing mechanisms and need to compete in product market. Base on game theory, we set advertisers' Ad channel choice model by taking competition in product market into consideration. The comparison of heterogeneous advertisers profit under two kinds of pricing mechanism - auction vs posted price when the advertisers know a certain consumers' search, click behavior pattern and purchase decision rule shows as the cost to provide high quality product reduce, High quality product advertiser prefers auction mechanism, while Low quality product advertiser prefers posted price. When consumers' search cost are decrease, namely, the proportion of consumers who would like purchase after comparison increase, the advertisers prefer posted price mechanism simultaneously.

articleTitle: System dynamics analysis for the impact of dynamic transport and information delay to disaster relief supplies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the disaster-relief operations, the emergency supplies usually suffer heavy and dynamic transport delay and information delay. The mechanism of how those delays influence the material flow and information flow is relatively less studied. In this paper, a system dynamics model is presented to describe the disaster-relief supply chain under dynamic transport and information delays. Three levels of each delay are generated respectively and nine scenarios are cross-constructed from them. The simulation results indicate that the transport delay influences the material flow directly, while the information delay impacts the system in multiple ways. Furthermore, two enhanced inventory desiring methods trying to suppress those impacts are discussed. The improvement of performance points out that both the level and the fluctuation of transport delay are affecting the final supply level.

articleTitle: Research on stability of technology innovation alliance based on the safeguard against opportunism
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The contract among technology innovation alliance members is incomplete, which substantially increases the probability of members taking opportunistic behavior, resulting in great damages to the stability of the alliance. In this paper, by the method of evolutionary game theory, we divided the context of alliance into weak intellectual property protection system and strong intellectual protection system, structured a dynamic system equation of stability of technology innovation alliance based on the safeguard against opportunism, discussed its stability and concluded the significant importance of intellectual property protection to the stability of technology innovation alliance. These results may provide the theoretical basis and reference value for these enterprises which will prepare to establish or already established the alliance and seek further development.

articleTitle: Spatial-temporal statistical analysis of Chengdu-Chongqing regional economic structure evolution — Based on comparative study with five major economic regions and four major urban groups
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The planning and development of Chengdu-Chongqing Economic Zone(CCEZ) has become one of the hotspot of regional economic development as well as is the core problem of leading and driving the rapid economic growth in China's western area. Based on the feature analysis on the economic structure evolution of CCEZ, this paper uses spatial statistical analysis to give a correlation analysis on the agglomeration state of regional economic development structure of the CCEZ since 2002. By comparing with the typical areas of five major economic zones and four major urban groups in China, from the perspective of time and space, this paper comprehensively analyzes the internal and external economic disparities of CCEZ and the evolution process of regional economic development, and thereby draws some relevant conclusions.

articleTitle: Research on consumer trust and satisfaction in mobile commerce
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Trust and satisfaction are essential ingredients for success business relationships in mobile commerce. Yet there is little research on trust and satisfaction in mobile commerce that takes a longitudinal approach. Based on the technology acceptance model, self-perception theory and expectation-confirmation theory, this study builds a two-stage theoretical model of consumer trust and satisfaction in the context of mobile banking, and discusses the effects on consumer trust on usage, perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use in the usage phase, the feedback effects of usage on perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use and confirmation and the evaluations mechanisms in the post-usage phase. The empirical results indicate that trust has influence on usage, perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use, usage has significant feedback on perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use and confirmation, confirmation has positive impacts on perceived usefulness and perceived ease of use, and users' evaluations have significant impact on satisfaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of building energy efficiency service market entrance uncertainty based on option gambling theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: It is regarded that building energy efficiency service market (BEESM) in China is still in the government pushing and demonstration process after about ten years of development. Although Government implemented a lot of incentive policies, as the marekt supply main body, energy service company (ESCo) doesn't really develop rapidly. To anylyse the contradiction between the management policy and the practice, the paper establishes options gambling model and analyses influencing factor of ESCo behavior choice of entering market. The analysis result shows that the intertemporal characteristic of the contract energy management (CEM) project results in ESCO's wait and see attitude of implementing the contract energy management project, which enables the CEM investment to have the economy risk. When the income of CEM project cannot meet ESCO requirements, ESCo hesitates greatly whether to develop the CEM project or not. CEM project's anticipated income and building energy efficiency cost are the key factors. Therefore more income, less cost and controlling CEM risk is helpful to implement CEM project for ESCo.

articleTitle: BRIC-countries potential and state policy of sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Now "the sustainable development" concept becomes a new social and economic paradigm of development. The potential of the economic progress which is based on a sustainable development, assumes qualitative improvements bigger, than economic growth. The BRIC-countries (Brazil, Russia, India, China) which become a world leaders in economic growth rates have a strong responsibility to provide an principles of sustainable development implementation take into account their biocapasity volume.

articleTitle: Managers' political connection, corporate diversification strategy and enterprise growth: Evidence from China's listed company of manufacturing industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The relationship between government and enterprises is the major issue in the process of economic reform in China, and how to study the mode of the relationship between enterprises and government and its efficiency is an urgent issue. This article does the research from the perspective of the relationship between managers' political connection and corporate diversification, and analyses specifically the effect of political connection on diversification and enterprise growth. The study found that higher political correlativity between government and enterprises indicate that political connection helps companies get more diversified resources. Meanwhile, the enterprises with higher political relativity bring higher enterprise growth through implementing diversification strategy, indicating that political connection can be recognized by the market as an alternative mechanism. The paper enriches the literature on enterprise diversification and the relationship between government and enterprises, meanwhile, it provide the reference for economic reform in China.

articleTitle: A new short-term load forecasting model of smart distribution grid
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Applying the improved gene expression programming arithmetic to optimization plan, the convergence rate and precision of the model can be improved, which can be used to load forecasting. Preprocessing the load sample data, and applying the flexible skills of the improved gene expression programming arithmetic, the paper forecasts the whole point load of future short-term to see the same point load sequence of different work-day as sample. Through a case analysis, the improved gene expression programming arithmetic has been proved to have more efficiency and faster convergence rate than optimization methods.

articleTitle: Research on the price negotiation mechanism of green supply chain of manufacturing industry from the angle of customer behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The manufacturing industry has brought the question of serious environmental pollution while makes the contribution for human economic development. In order to achieve coordinated development of economy and environment, manufacturing enterprise need to implement green supply chain operation. The price of green product will increase for the use of green material and technology in the manufacturing industry implementing green supply chain operation. The price is the important factor impacting on the customer purchase behavior. In order to improve competitiveness and conquer more market share, the subjects of green supply chain must be negotiate the price of green product reasonably. This treatise has structured the model of negotiation mechanism of green supply chain price and discussed the price of green products, the profit of supplier, the profit of manufacturer and the profit of whole green supply chain under the condition of negotiation or non-negotiation of price respectively from the angle of customer behavior.

articleTitle: Pricing model for commercial real estate rent based on real option
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to avoid business risks caused by the fluctuation of the commercial real estate rents, real option theory is applied in this paper to solve the problem of commercial real estate rent. First of all, this paper turns uncertain volatility of the commercial real estate rent into the particular random process which could describe its mathematical characteristics with some parameters; Secondly, this paper uses Monte Carlo simulation and Asian options to set up a pricing model of the commercial real estate rents; Finally it calculates the specific parameters by analyzing the fluctuation of Grade A office building rent in the last ten years in Hong Kong, and reveals the impact of the pricing model on commercial real estate rents. The results show that on the premise of guaranteeing lessors and tenants' interest, the application of real option in commercial real estate rent could reduce the business risk, and deduce the rent fluctuation.

articleTitle: Prediction based on support vector machine for travel choice of high-speed railway passenger in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: High-speed railway is a very important part of transportation industry in China, and travel choice has key effect on the development of high-speed railway. Therefore, research on travel behavior of passengers and prediction their travel choice, will offer valuable suggestion for high-speed railway running. In this paper, support vector machine (SVM) is the main method being used to predict. Support vector machine is based on the structural risk minimization principle, and it improves the generalization ability of learning machine to the maximum extent. When solving the limited-sample and nonlinear problems, support vector machine has advantages in predicting. In this research, we get six most important factors, which affect travel choice by the means of questionnaire survey, then use libsvm tool to build prediction model and optimize the train parameters of support vector machine. Finally the prediction accuracy is as high as 91.44%, which shows that support vector machine is good at predicting.

articleTitle: Reseach of security risk identification based on rough set theory for highway subgrade stability in the slope of reservoir
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: There are many security risk factors which affect highway subgrade stability in the slope of reservoir. These security risk actors not only are uncertainty and information imperfect, but also have very complex risk characteristic, which rock-soil of primary landform of highway subgrade along the reservoir line is polyphase difference construction and interrelationship of risk factors. In this paper, aiming at these characteristics of security risk of highway subgrade stability in the slope of reservoir, based on rough set theory, a security risk identification model has been established to control the security risk. Application of the model has been provided through the case of security risk identification of highway subgrade stability in the slope of reservoir, in Bainan section Yunyang county, YuBa road. The results of the application demonstrate that small amount of information is required only, analysis and calculation have higher efficiency, and the accuracy can meet the needs of risk analysis through the security risk identification model based on rough set theory. The case confirms that this model can be provided to decision support for the late disaster management of Three Gorges Reservoir.

articleTitle: Research on decision-making effectiveness factors of top management team
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the establishment of the models how the effect of TMT decision-making be influenced, the paper elaborates the source of the differences in decision-making like demographic characteristics and heterogeneity which affect the effect of the decisions indirectly through factors like TMT composition, TMT DM process control, DM flow etc. Clarifying these factors in the effectiveness of the whole TMT decision-making process is of important significance in reasonably controlling TMT structure, establishing scientific TMT decision-making flow, enhancing the team's cohesion, upgrading decision-making effectiveness and improving TMT's performance as well as a firm's performance.

articleTitle: Research on technological trajectories based on patent documents and related empirical study
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Technological innovation and progress always follow a certain direction and trajectory. In the era of emerging technologies, people want to pre-identify the trajectories of technological development to help them work out strategies and response measures. In this paper, theory, models and empirical analysis was integrated. The paper conducts the analysis of emerging technologies to determine potential for development and future direction from the perspective of the patent and analysis of patent data. First introduces the definition and development of technological trajectories. The application and limit of S-curve method when used in the research on technological trajectories has also been analyzed. Using patent information to discuss industrial technological trajectories has been proposed, and an empirical research on laptop batteries has been given. Forecasting the ending of existing battery technology and the beginning of future technology has been considered as key problem, therefore three problems have been analyzed: increment of patent quantity, technology updating speed, stakeholders.

articleTitle: Impact of objective and subjective task complexity on employee performance and satisfaction: Moderating role of psychological capital
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This article explores the impacts of subjective task complexity (STC), objective task complexity (OTC) on employee performance and employee satisfaction, specifically, it examines the moderating role of psychological capital (PsyCap) on the impacts. On the basis of a sample survey, the paper uses hierarchical regression and makes the following conclusions: (1) STC, OTC and employee performance are negatively correlated; (2) STC's correlation with employee satisfaction is not significantly negative; on the contrary, OTC was negatively correlated with employee satisfaction; (3)PsyCap acts as a moderator of the relation between STC and employee satisfaction, but the moderating role of PsyCap in STC-employee performance relations is not obvious; (4) PsyCap moderates both OTC - employee performance relations and OTC-employee satisfaction relations. Finally, the article points out the contribution of this study, limitations and future directions.

articleTitle: Study on Auditing Immune System: Based-on data envelopment analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Combining the economic immune function of auditing and the characteristics of Data Envelopment Analysis, this study proposes Auditing Immune System and focuses on the simulative connection of Auditing Immune System and Biological Immune System. Considering the key function of Biological Immune System is to distinguish the “Self” and “Non-self”, and eliminate the “Non-self”, this paper employs the “Efficiency” and “Inefficiency” in data envelopment analysis to match “Self” and “Non-self” in Biological Immune System. To increase the efficiency of inefficient decision making units and realize Auditing Immune System's immune defense, immune homeostasis and immune surveillance, this research regards the “risk” as the antigen in Auditing Immune System and facilitates the realization of a multi-level, diversified, self-study, and memory Auditing Immune System.

articleTitle: Real estate bubble in China: An empirical study based on VaR model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Real estate market in China has developed rapidly these years and enjoys brilliant achievements, but at the same time certain problems such as high mortgage level and soaring housing price come out, arousing public concern of bubble in Chinese real estate market. In this paper, we intensively discussed statistical models including VaR models and heavy tail models to explain the phenomenon of high frequency of market bubble occurrence. We also use historical simulation VaR model, which is a widely used statistical model and has been proved successful in financial market bubble analysis, to calculate the Value at Risk for Chinese Housing Price Index January 2011. Based on analysis, certain suggestions such as the construction of real estate industry database, the creation of sound bubble risk monitoring and administration system are given, in order to prevent dangerous property bubble from happening again.

articleTitle: Determination of weight vector for the scheme optimization of construction project using fuzzy analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Today, the application of value engineering in the scheme optimization of construction project is getting more and more mature. While, determination of the function weight is one of the critical decision milestones for realizing the quantitative evaluation of value engineering. The main aim of this paper is to structure a practical application model on determining index weights of evaluation system for construction scheme selection. Basic principles of triangle fuzzy number and index number scale are introduced. Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process (FAHP), based on the index number scale, is utilized to model the weight vector determination. Then, after structuring the fundamental hierarchic system, the model is performed with a case application on scheme optimization of a teaching and laboratory building in campus. The weight vector of function evaluation index system is figured out, and the methodology is clarified.

articleTitle: Modeling solution and properties research on the General GM(1,1) model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Discrete GM(1,1) model solves the bias defect in homogeneous exponential fitting using GM (1,1) model. General GM(1,1) model solves the conversion problem of the original equation between differential form and differential form, and can effectively profile GM(1,1) model and Discrete GM(1,1) model. But, the modeling mechanism, solution approach and lots of good properties about General GM(1,1) model do not take in-depth studying. So that, we research the mechanism of the General GM(1,1) modeling and three solution approaches about the stepwise ratio including the fitting approach of initial information, the fitting approach of new information and the overall error minimization approach in this paper. Then, we further detailed analysis some important properties such as the general nature, the fitting optimization property, the homogeneous exponential property and the unbiased property to fit homogeneous exponent. At last, the feasibility and the optimization properties are confirmed through an real example. Then, General GM(1,1) model and Grey Prediction Theory could be effetely improved and perfected for this article.

articleTitle: Analysis on efficiency of Chinese New Rural Cooperative Medical Insurance System based on DEA method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings

articleTitle: Empirical study of investment performance on listed banks from Shanghai Stock Exchange based on one-quarter holding period
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings

articleTitle: Structural dynamic game mechanism of customer value and enterprise performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This study introduces customer value with enterprise performance of structured dynamic game mechanism, the key points and difficulties from three aspects elaborated on customer satisfaction and corporate performance structured dynamic game mechanism of mathematical model, and based on this, puts forward improving enterprise performance strategy.

articleTitle: Trade remedy effect of US antidumping measures on China;s agricultural products: From the perspective of the third market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Trade remedy measures such as antidumping are generally believed to provide effective protection for the plaintiff. However, the protection may be much lower than plaintiff's expectation, if considering the third market effect. In our paper, we analyzed the trade deflection effect of US antidumping measures to China's agricultural product from the perspective of the third market, using the dynamic panel data models. The results showed that the anti-dumping measure by the US on China's agricultural products has diverted the trade flow of China's agricultural exports to the third markets, partly taking up the room of US export to the same market, leaving the protection effect in fact falling down on the expectation of the country of plaintiff. The conclusion of the paper has provided a trade remedy effect analysis of Sino-US trade from a new perspective, and provided useful policy reference for future bilateral and multi-lateral trade negotiations.

articleTitle: Research on the formation of regulatory capture: A fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Traditional regulatory capture theory couldn't tell us what is on earth the cause of capture even though it has experienced many paradigms evolution, which bring some limitations to its application. We study the root of capture and the hidden trade pattern in our country based on fuzzy set qualitative comparative analysis, and find there are several trading models hidden in captured phenomenon which are related to types of the enterprise, government intervene and capture approaches. The study will not only improve and enrich the theory, but also have important practical significance for government regulation reform.

articleTitle: Research on quality profit and loss analysis model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This article introduces the concept of quality level and combines quality costs and quality revenue organically. Models have been established based on the analysis of the relationship between costs and revenue and quality level. The article takes the maximum quality profit and loss as the ultimate index in deciding best quality level. Taking ZX's product information in domestic system as an example, the article analyzes the quality profit and loss model and proves that best quality level is neither 100% nor the minimum total quality costs put forward by traditional models, but the maximum quality profit and loss. The quality profit and loss model overcomes both the weakness of the minimum total quality cost in traditional models and 100% qualified in zero defects theory, and revises the relationship between costs and quality level. In addition, this article made comparative analysis of traditional models and the quality profit and loss model by using real data of the enterprise. And it proves that the quality profit and loss model is more appropriate for practical situation of total quality cost management in the circumstance of modern production management. It has directive function to the enterprise's quality cost management.

articleTitle: Study on pricing level of C2C electronic commerce platform
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In recent years, with the popularity of the Internet in China C2C shopping websites are booming. Although large-scale have accumulated the number of users, but still no one can achieve our profit C2C platform. As a new business model, electronic commerce has made a significant influence on people's life. Firstly this paper divides the user's utility into the utility associated with risk and the utility not related to risk. Because the particularity of the network environment, the user's utility is affected by risk factors. Secondly we focus on the factors influencing on optimal pricing level of C2C electronic commerce network in three stages, which included network externalities, income, the level of credit and service cost. Finally we draw some conclusions which provide certain guiding significance for people.

articleTitle: Semidefinite programming relaxation for portfolio selection with higher order moments
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the nor-normal distribution and nor-binomial utility function of investors, higher-order moments should be taken into consideration with portfolio selection. So far, studies on portfolio selection with higher-order moments are mainly conducted under the framework of mean-variance-skewness while kurtosis is seldom taken into account. But many literatures have pointed out kurtosis play more important role in portfolio selection than variance and skewness. So, in order to fill up the study gap, portfolio selection with higher-order moments will be studied, under the framework of mean-variance-skewness-kurtosis, in this paper. Firstly, the optimization model of portfolio selection with kurtosis minimization is set up. Then, semidefinite programming relaxation is suggested based on research results of Lasserre and Waki to resolve the difficulty of model solution from the higher order and non-convexity of objective function and the efficient frontier of portfolio selection model minimizing kurtosis is deduced theoretically. Finally, the theoretical efficient frontier and the effectiveness of semidefinite programming relaxation are verified through empirical analysis.

articleTitle: A method for multi-attribute decision making based on ER-AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As a nascent method of multi-criteria decision-making with uncertainty, DS/AHP is similar to the analytic hierarchy process (AHP) in structure and its analytic processes are based on Dempster-Shafer (DS) theory. However, it is unsuitable to deal with the multi-attribute decision making with incomplete information, especially the attributes with missing values. In this paper, a new method for multiple-attribute decision making based on ER-AHP has been proposed, which incorporates the Evidential Reasoning (ER) algorithm with AHP. Firstly, each alternative is compared with the negative ideal alternative under an attribute to form the decision table by experts. Then a new basic probability assignment function (BPA) is constructed to express the incomplete information and some properties of the function are proved. After then, based on the results of aggregation which combines the attributes of each alternative by the ER algorithm, the alternatives are sorted and selected. Finally, the ER-AHP is compared with the DS / AHP through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Influencing factors regression analysis of low-carbon agriculture in Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Global warming has become a worldwide subject. As the second-largest greenhouse gas emissions sources, agriculture has tremendous potential. It can play an important role in greenhouse gas emission reduction and make the traditional high carbon agriculture transfer to low carbon agriculture. Based on the regression analysis on total agricultural output, crop acreage, total power of agricultural machinery, the amount of fertilizers, pesticides and agricultural films in Heilongjiang Province, the study shows fertilizer input is the major factor in low-carbon agriculture in Heilongjiang Province. According to current rate of fertilizer input, agricultural output target of Heilongjiang Province can't be completed at the end of the twelfth five-year planning. However, many ways, including fertilizer efficiency improvement, new fertilizer technologies and farmland carbon sink storage, will not only accomplish the expected target with less fertilizers but also reduce greenhouse gas emissions.

articleTitle: Innovation within outsourcing relationships: Contemplation of Luhmann's theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Outsourcing parts of ICT-related activities to third parties is maturing. Since the late eighties of the last century, companies are looking for cost reduction and competitive advantage using this strategy. Since the outsourcing relationships also matures, innovation is becoming more and more part of the contract. The most difficult way of innovation is within that relationship. To be successful, input is required from both the supplier's side as well as the client's side. If systematic collaboration is performed, it changes the structure of organizations. That is, organizations adapt to each others strategy and each others corporate culture. Luhmann's theory of autopoietic systems will portray the difficulties of aligning decisions and decisions premises when two companies are involved, especially concerning innovation within outsourcing relationships. This paper provides a new view of outsourcing and innovation within outsourcing relationship, using Luhmann theories.

articleTitle: Econometric analysis of the relationships among the financial markets
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: A two-step optimization method called inference functions for margins (IFM) is broadly adopted to estimate Copula-GARCH models. However, IFM is subject to small-sample bias. This paper proposes to estimate Copula-GARCH models by applying Maximization by Parts (MBP), a multi-step optimization algorithm. This method decomposes the complicated log likelihood into two parts. In the decomposition, the first part is an easy likelihood consisting of only marginal likelihoods. The second part includes dependence parameters from a multivariate likelihood and is used to update the estimates from the first part. The results indicate that MBP can provide more efficient estimation than IFM.

articleTitle: Comparative study on economic efficiency of each region in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: China's economy has not broken away from the extensive high input development mode, and economic efficiency is low. Economic efficiency problem can never be avoided in the future economic development. This paper comparatively evaluate economic efficiency of each region, and propose the corresponding improvement measures, based on the DEA theory of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>R and BC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model, with 31 regions' economic efficiency as the research object, from the input-output Angle, and through technical efficiency, scale efficiency and production frontier projection. The empirical results show that each region of our nation have a great difference in economic efficiency and the cause of efficiency differences is different, and economic development efficiency of Beijing, Shanghai, etc. are the highest. There's a large connection between regional economic efficiency difference and regional economic inharmonious development.

articleTitle: A study of public expenditure deviation in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper studies the deviation of public expenditure in China, uses the public expenditure samples of 1998-2008 to obtain both comprehensive and single deviation of provincial public expenditure, and makes comparative analysis. Comprehensive deviation, at province level, shows the U-type trend of expenditure deviation, while coefficient of single deviation shows the L-type trend. Public expenditure, at region level, shows higher level of deviation in the center than in the east or the west. And the most significant deviation is from infrastructure cost among all types of public expenditure, which implies that government pay much more money for economic growth, but not people's welfare and social security.

articleTitle: Organization analysis: An application of cusp catastrophe theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: An organization is a complex system that consists of many departments involving each other. Thus, internal and external factors can complexly impact the organization. The changing in these factors can also trigger latent problems of an organization. If the problems are accumulated, the organization can be led into an unstable state. This article focuses on applying a stochastic cusp catastrophe to construct a model for monitoring the organization status. In addition, we employ internal strengths and external risks of the companies as the important control factors for both asymmetry and bifurcation sides. Finally, the model is reviewed by using two statistical testing methods: the presence of the bifurcation point, and the fitness of the model using the Cusp fit package in R software. The results show that the Cusp model is better than both linear and logistic models.

articleTitle: Evolutionary game analysis on hidden irregularity of processing enterprises in dairy supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Frequent dairy products quality safe accidents make the government and consumers concern more about hidden irregularities in dairy supply chain. The hidden irregularities include adulteration of dairy farmers and milk stations, producing fake of processing enterprises and selling fake of sales networks. In this paper, dairy processing enterprises as the research object, it is realistic significance to analyze hidden irregularity of processing enterprises by making use of evolutionary game analysis method because of enterprise's bounded rationality. The purpose of this paper is to analyze the long-term evolutionary trend of hidden irregularity of processing enterprises by applying replication dynamics mechanism of evolutionary game theory on the condition of bounded rationality. In this paper, on the basic of evolutionary game theory and method, we create the evolutionary game of hidden irregularity of processing enterprises, and then analyze dynamical evolutionary process. The analysis results indicate that the impact factors of hidden irregularity of processing enterprises are the marginal revenue of inferior dairy products, the penalty amount of inferior dairy products and the probability of finding inferior dairy products. Only government departments increase the supervision intensity and strength against inferior dairy products, it will improve dairy products quality and to promote the healthy development of dairy industry.

articleTitle: A model of interdisciplinary research based on the double knowledge innovation view
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Interdisciplinary research is an important organizational pattern with integration of heterogeneous knowledge, modes of thinking and motivation to solve complexity engineering problems, based on innovative tasks. To clarify and analyze knowledge innovation mechanism of interdisciplinary research is conducive to effectively management and operation interdisciplinary organization. Based on the analysis of the static and dynamic knowledge innovation perspectives, this paper further constructed the model of interdisciplinary research to reveal interdisciplinary research emphases, features and functions. The model, incorporating three core dimensions of interdisciplinary research, embodies the macroscopic characteristics of selection the relevant disciplines to expand knowledge and organization boundaries and the microscopic characteristics of dynamically integration of different knowledge units with members consciously learning, according to the goals of organization innovation.

articleTitle: The influence factors of customer recognition research — Based on perceived value
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The rapidly changing market environment technology progress intensifies, customer speed personalized needs more diverse and lead to the increasingly fierce competition between enterprises and more and more companies began to seek a new competitive advantage, how to improve the client's perceived value and make consumers produce customer identity gradually become the key enterprises to gain the competitive advantage. This article through studies in mobile phone brand experience shops that influence consumer customer recognition factor, puts forward consumer product knowledge, brand reputation and store image of enterprise will affect consumer perception of value, thus through perceived value to influence its customers agree the mechanism, and draw the consumer product knowledge through perceived value factors such as the intermediate variables can make consumers produce customer recognition conclusion.

articleTitle: Measure analysis of restructuring contributions to KunGangJiaHua of YunNanKunGang Cement Building materials Co., LTD
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In December of 2008, the state-owned company invested by KunMing Steel holding company was built, which was restructured by HongHe Flux LTD., YunNan KunGangJiaHua Cement LTD., BaoShan KunGangJiaHua Cement LTD., and QuJing KunGangJiaHua Cement LTD., etc The restructuring contributed much to the optimization of the regional cement industry structure and the development of business. So the paper selected KunGangJiaHua company as the research object, which was the subsidiary of YunNanKunGang Cement Building materials Co., LTD. The writer modeled the measure of gray multilevel integration (AHP-GRAP model) with the combination of analytic hierarchy process and Grey Relation Analysis. In addition, empirical evidence was also analyzed by using the data. The contributions of restructuring were well-evaluated. The value of evaluation showed that the evaluation value was increasing. The benefit of restructuring was rising year by year.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies of networked technical service oriented product process
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With the development of computer technology and network technology, networked manufacturing technology and networked manufacturing system have been more and more attention. As a new method, networked technical service oriented product process is presented for manufacturing companies to meet the rapid response to market demand and provide efficient technical services. In this paper, firstly, ontology-based semantic identification technology has been studied. The algorithm of semantic identification for technical service information in production is described. Secondly, made use of fuzzy analytic hierarchy process and the Hungarian algorithm, the queue and assignment of the technical services task in production are researched respectively. Finally, the prototype system of networked technical service oriented product process is carried out to verify the correctness and feasibility of the researched techniques.

articleTitle: Research on methods of evaluating the refined safety management in the coal industry based on fuzzy mathematics
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the process of management, many concepts and methods have indistinct concepts as human's most thoughts and language, which therefore can be adapted to the quantitative operations of management based on the fuzzy mathematics. This article focuses on two impact-factors of personnel and organization, which mostly influnce the performance in refined safety management in the coal industry, and proposed a new method of comprehensive evaluating that based on fuzzy mathematics according to the related data analysis of Yanghe Coal Industry and Xinmin Coal Industry. This method can help us make quantitative analysis and decision on the performance of the coal refined safety management and promote the security performance of coal enterprises in China.

articleTitle: Principal-agent model and risk analysis under asymmetric information condition
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The paper describes a kind of principal-agent model under asymmetric information condition from actual economic life. Through the analysis on optimal solution of the model, we discover that the risk appetite of the agent has a direct effect on the optimal incentive mechanism and the risk sharing of principal and agent, and also endow a parameter in the incentive contract with new economic presentation.

articleTitle: Licensing as a vehicle of external finance under network effects
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Although a lot of scholars have offered valuable insights into licensing, there is little theoretical research on the role of licensing contracts as a vehicle of external finance for technology innovation. By addressing specific issues in markets with network effects, demand uncertainty, and the innovator's difficulties in financing of follow-on investments in development and commercialization of the licensed technology, we demonstrate how the innovator can manage the trade-offs between expected licensing revenues losses and upfront fee payments which the licensee may finance. What's more, conditional on the intensity of network effects, the ex-ante licensing contract involves a fixed fee component, either alone for high intensity of network effects or in combination with a royalty component for low intensity of network effects. We also explore how ex-ante licensing contract can both dissuade potential licensees from challenging the patent's validity and alleviate the financing problem when firms have financial constraint.

articleTitle: Analysis on the character of CO2 emissions per outputs of final energy consumption in manufacturing in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: It's the key to reduce the energy intensity of industrial sector, to reduce emissions. What's more, manufacturing is important to the industrial sector. Therefore, from the point of final energy consumption, this paper studies the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions per outputs in the manufacturing. With Logarithmic Mean Weight Divisia(LMD) method, a decomposition model of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions is built. And, 1994 as the base year, it analyzes the characteristics of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions per outputs in manufacturing from 1999 to 2007. The conclusion: first, in the past few years, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions per outputs in manufacturing tended to decline; second, the coal-dominated energy structure had the restrain effect on reducing CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions per outputs, but the fuel efficiency was the driving factor; third, the fuel structure had the greater potential than the fuel efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on the formation mechanism of the innovative enterprises growth path in less developed regions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Defined the Innovative Enterprises growth path and the less developed region, summarized the characteristics of the Less Developed Regions of China and the types of it, explained the growth process of the Innovative Enterprises that the innovative enterprises achieve the developing goals through interaction between the quality growth and the quantity growth of the innovative enterprises, analyzed the formation of the innovative enterprises growth path by means of the complexity theory, revealed the innovative enterprise growth path including gradual path, mutant path, and hybrid path. According to the regional factors characteristics of the less developed regions and the performance of natural, political, economic, social, cultural, and technological factors, summed up the basic innovative enterprise growth path in Less Developed Regions based on the research of Innovative Enterprises growth path.

articleTitle: Discussions on the role of enterprises culture of Daqing in management of petroleum industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The establishment and development of Daqing Petroleum culture, which has been a classic case of spiritual promotion to enterprise growth, can be traced to more than half contrary ago. In recent years, with continuous challenging from both inside factors and outside economic situation, innovation to current enterprise culture is needed for further development of Daqing Petroleum Corporation Limited. Here we systematically analyzed current situation of culture in Daqing Petroleum Corporation. Based on those facts, we proposed principles and pathways for Daqing Petroleum Corporation to construct modern enterprise culture, namely to uniform corporations value, to nurture corporation spirit, to boost management idea, to strength corporation system, to organize brand, to rebuild corporation's figure in public. Through these procedures, the enterprise culture system will be perfected stably, with the endeavor from both managers and employees as supporting. The long-term carrying on of modern enterprise culture enabled spiritual Chinese Petroleum enterprise culture.

articleTitle: Study of accounting firm's partnership culture based on fuzzy evaluation method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The partnership culture in accounting firms determines cohesion and competition power from a CPA firm. The focus on market competition will be accounting partnership culture of competition. There are significant differences between the accounting firm's partnership culture with people integration as their important characteristics and common companies with fund integration. Based on international experience and CIS(Corporate Identity System) theory, this paper creatively proposes the design ideas of evaluation system of accounting firm's partnership culture, establishing the leading evaluation layer with accounting firm's concept system, behavioral system, and visual system, While the auxiliary evaluation layers is constructed. Then we adopt fuzzy evaluation method to make comprehensive evaluation on accounting firm's partnership culture, in order to further optimize our accounting firm's internal governance mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of diversification strategy on analyst following in Chinese listed companies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper did a research on the relationship between diversification strategy and analyst following. Firstly it analyzed how diversification strategy affected on analyst following in theory. And then it did an empirical study between them by two-stage least squares(2SLS), choosing 299 listed companies in Shanghai stock market from 2007 to 2009 as research samples. The result showed that the companies' diversified degree had negative correlation with analyst following significantly. The reason might be that diversified companies are more complex than specialized ones and securities analysts would pay more information cost on the former. So considering their private benefit, analysts will care more about specialized companies than diversified ones. The findings could provide inspiration for company management, investors and other participators in securities market.

articleTitle: An empirical study on farmers' consumer intention for agriculture machinery operations demand in Shanxi province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With questionnaire survey, the paper analyze the farmers' consumer intention of agriculture machinery operation, provide objective recommendations for farmers' consume behavior, scientific management inspiration for agricultural machinery owners and provide scientific guidance for government departments from the perspective of consumer psychology. On the basis of the Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB), the paper put designs a model to analyze the farmers' consumer intention of agriculture machinery operation, through the investigated data in Shanxi Province, by adopting Logistic regression to authenticate the model. The empirical results show the key factors which influence farmers' consumer intention of agriculture machinery operation is family income, arable land area, largest land area, cognitive component, convenience etc and different factors have different effects, while the other factors have weak influence.

articleTitle: Carbon abatement choice: Administration or market?
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Global warming calls for different schemes to mitigate carbon emission. Most of related policy can be classified into two categories: administrative and market. From a micro-level, in this paper, a simple optimization model was developed to clarify impacts of administrative and market carbon emission abatement scheme on firm's production plan and expected net income when the firm is confronted with a random demand on its product. By calculating firm's optimal amount of product and corresponding expected net income, we find that command-and-control approach is strictest one. And to some extent, it may cause inefficiency of resources utilization and market failure because this scheme imposes a hard constraint on firm's product plan. However, schemes such as administrative and market scheme are preferable though they may lead to inefficiency and market failure too, but to less extent. The reason is that without the hard constraint on firm's product plan, these schemes present more options so the firm can make more profits by trading off between carbon abating and burdening the cost of over-emissions.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation of manufacturing enterprises' core competitiveness based on the catastrophe progression method
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: For the subjectivity in weight evaluation which is in the methods of Analytic Hierarchy Process, Factor Analysis, Fuzzy Cluster Analysis, etc widely used during the evaluation of manufacturing enterprises' core competitiveness, the catastrophe progression method (CPM) is introduced into evaluating the ability. The paper makes the sifted index screening of the core competitiveness evaluation of manufacturing enterprises by using the combination of experience determination method and grey statistic method and it also decides the six categories and including seventeen indexes: getting resource-gotten ability, manufacturing ability, management ability, innovation ability, marketing ability and enterprise culture. This paper constructs the core competitiveness evaluation model of manufacturing enterprise by using CPM and then makes an empirical research. Empirical results show that this combined method is proved to be effective in the evaluation of manufacturing enterprises' core competitiveness.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the day-of-the-week liquidity patterns in Chinese Stock Index Futures market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper examines the day-of-the-week liquidity effect of CSI300 Stock Index Futures. Empirical results show that the day-of-the-week liquidity pattern exhibits a reverse V-shaped for the CSI300 index futures. The regression analysis results consistent with previous analysis also demonstrate the day-of-the-week liquidity have statistically significant effect. Furthermore, this paper investigates the influencing factors to stock index futures liquidity and give some recommendations for the trading regime of Chinese Stock Index Futures market.

articleTitle: The happiness of customer cocreation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In postmodern world, customers are not satisfied with passively receiving products or services; on the contrary, they show more and more interests on actively cocreating the products with firms. However, marketing literature still lacks powerful explanations to understand why customers enjoy the cocreation process although they need to input much of their time and effort in it. This study builds a framework of customer cocreation based on eudaimonic (the pleasure of self-actualization) vs. hedonic (the pleasure of needs fulfillment) theory, and further tests the relevant hypotheses by using real DIY products as experiment stimuli. Results show that eudaimnoic happiness and hedonic happiness have powerful explanation to the customer perception of cocreation process and the type of firm's facilitation can moderate the effect of customer cocreation on eudaimonic happiness, hedonic happiness and customer satisfaction. Theory contributions and managerial implications are discussed in the end.

articleTitle: Evaluation of knowledge complementary degree for creative industry cluster based on BP neural networks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Creative industries are intelligent, highly knowledgeable. Cluster model increasingly becomes the main economic organization form of the world creative industry. Getting complementary knowledge and realizing the knowledge complementary within creative industry cluster is the main motivation of each cooperator. What's more, the complementary degree of knowledge also determines the development altitude of creative industry cluster. So, the BP neural network model was applied to evaluate the degree of knowledge complementary within the creative industry cluster. This paper constructs the creative industry cluster evaluation index system of knowledge complementary degree. Simultaneously, the paper has proposed the method to evaluate the creative industry cluster knowledge complementary degree based on BP Neural Networks. The study indicates that BP neural network is a model without linear mapping. It can give a satisfactory effort while the indices with a high level of correlation, nonlinear changing and data lacking. So, it's a relatively optimum method used for forecasting, with wide applying area and high value of popularizing.

articleTitle: The research of East Asian monetary cooperation based on symmetry of economic shocks
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Regional monetary cooperation has been the focus of the international financial sector issues for a long time. And the study on East Asian monetary cooperation has great practical significance to prevent financial crises and to promote regional economic development. This paper establishes VAR model to examine the East Asian economies' symmetry of the supply shock and demand shock. The empirical results show that, the symmetry of economic shocks between the East Asian small nations remains high, and in recent years the most notable change is that the symmetry between the East Asian large members represented by China and Japan increases evidently. From this point of view, this paper argues that further monetary cooperation in East Asia should shift from “crisis driven” cooperation to “power driven” cooperation.

articleTitle: Study on the Chinese education's performance in the development of rural economy and society: Based on the analysis of statistical data from 10th Five-Year
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Under the background that the central government keeps on investing the rural education, and by the DEA method, this paper commits itself to analyzing the performance of Chinese education in the development of rural area during 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> Five-Year. It is found that the performance during 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> Five-Year tends to be stable but differs a lot in different districts. Accordingly, this paper offers some policy proposals to further the development of rural education from two aspects, increasing fund inputs in the rural education and enhancing the efficiency of fund allocation.

articleTitle: Research of indemnificatory housing object divided based on cluster analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Within the government vigorously promoting, indemnificatory housing achieved the positive results, but the division of the object of indemnificatory housing is still the difficulty of the policy-making. This article starts from the characteristic elements of the object of indemnificatory housing, using the theory of cluster analysis and SPSS software to classify the objects, and analysis of interview data. The results show that cluster analysis can divide the object of indemnificatory housing clearly. And the research is the innovative exploration of method on objects of housing security.

articleTitle: The quality difference analysis between environmental patents and non-environmental patents in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Many scholars think that the patent authorization and its surviving time represent the quality level of the patent - which means the patent with higher authorization rate and longer surviving time has higher quality than the one with lower authorization rate and shorter surviving time. This paper firstly makes a comparison of the authorization and surviving time of China's environmental and non-environmental patents. Then it compares the technical complexity of them with patent classification number. After the comparison, we found that both the quality level and the technical level of China's environmental patent are lower than that of its adjacent non-environmental patent technology. This paper analyzes the major reason is that not all sectors of the society with government as the main body have paid enough attention to the research and development of environmental patents for a long time. At last, it puts forwards thoughts on the development of China's environmental patents.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the relationship of export trade and carbon emissions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this research, firstly we calculate the carbon emissions of China from 1978 to 2009 by the Guide to the calculation of carbon emissions from IPCC (Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change), secondly we analyze the long term and short term relationships between carbon emissions and the exports in China by the cointegration theory and the error correction model separately, and through granger causality test, we conclude that there is a unidirectional causality between carbon emission and the exports in China. These results indicate that goods exports have been an important factor accelerating China carbon emission in recent years. Besides, we also predict the carbon emissions during the 12th Five-Year Plan of China by dynamic iterative prediction method. At last we propose the measures on the reduction of Carbon emission from the perspective of international trade.

articleTitle: Cointegration analysis of the export trade and energy consumption of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper does empirical analysis for the relationship between the energy consumption and export trade of Beijing based on the data about the total energy consumption and total export trade volume of Beijing during the period from 1980 to 2009 and by making use of a cointegration theory and a Granger causality test and establishing an error correction model (ECM). According to the analysis result, the energy consumption and export trade of Beijing had a cointegration relationship, namely a long-term equilibrium relationship and the changes of energy consumption of Beijing were the causes of the changes of the export trade scale of Beijing, which suggests that the energy consumption of Beijing had a certain promoting impact on the export trade of Beijing. It is therefore necessary for Beijing to ensure a equilibrium relationship between its energy consumption and export trade on the basis of sound and fast development of its economy so that its export trade can develop in a healthy way while its energy safety is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Study on the control mechanism of ecological costs based on the urban economic space evolution
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Urban economic space system and urban ecological system constitute a coupling system. And this kind of coupling realized through the flow that is on the connections among elements. So the plus entropy flow of this coupling system can be considers to the ecological costs of system self-organization evolution. The research and analysis of this paper is started with those conclusions, and established in the geographical ecological system point, and based on the harmony theory of human-earth relationship, and used the method of complex system and evolvement economy. This paper analyses the coupling relationship of urban economic space system and urban ecological system, and constructs the coupling entropy model. And in this paper the coupling degree is regard as a state parameter when quantitative analyses the coupling process of urban economic space-ecological coupling system. Then put forward the way of measure the coupling entropy. Based on those researches above this paper construct the control mechanism model of ecological costs of urban economic space which can provide theory and method for the quantitative analysis the urban economic space-ecological coupling system, and then can analysis the structure of ecological costs and accounting system according to the system growth rate of resource consumption and system natural renew ability during the urban economic space evolution.

articleTitle: Rationing and pricing with strategic consumer behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: We study the optimal inventory and pricing of a fashion-like seasonal goods in a market containing both strategic and nonstrategic customers. We categorize strategies into three classes, different from each other in two dimensions: single stage versus two-stage pricing and rationing versus unrationing quantities. When discount rate is exogenous, research shows rationing and dynamic pricing outperforms other two strategies only if there is a sufficiently large segment of high-valuation customers and the proportion of strategic consumer is medium. When discount rate is endogenous, we conduct a comprehensive numerical study to explore the impact of discount in the second stage and find that only by applying appropriate discounts could retailers maximize profit, and excessive competition on discount would do harm to retailers.

articleTitle: A study of a “Concussion-Response” chaotic synchronization pattern for enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Chaos derives from random concussion and fluctuation. Due to the ubiquity of uncertainty and nonlinearity, an enterprise is always in complex internal and external environments. Chaos has become a normality, and traditional strategic management theory and methods, based on the assumption of simplicity and linearity, no longer apply. Management science requires new theoretical methods to help enterprises cope with the changes of the concussive environment, so as to realize the adaptive evolution from chaos. This article presents a “Concussion-Response” chaotic synchronization pattern illustrating the process of enterprises' adjustment to the environment, analyses the essential factors of concussion and response subsystems in the enterprise system, based on which a chaotic synchronization pattern is established using Lorenz equations set, and at the end presents the chaotic synchronization strategy matrix for enterprises.

articleTitle: Ownership, competition, corporate governance and performance: Evidence from the Chinese listed companies in utilities sectors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: During the past decades, different types of reform have been introduced in a different order in various public utilities in China. The present combinations of privatization, competition and regulation reforms are varied across these monopoly industries and thus provide an opportunity for comparing the performances of the different kinds of the reforms. Based on a cross-sectional data from Chinese listed companies in 7 utility sectors, this study examined the impact of ownership, competition and corporate governance on performance index in terms of companies and industries. The effect of corporate governance is not observed in this sample. Electricity sectors perform better than other utilities industries but within this subsample production gain is negatively related to private ownership. The production abilities of companies in water, airline and telecommunication sectors are significantly inferior to electricity sectors which also have a significantly lower cost than railway and airline industries. For rail and airline industries, the percentages of private shares are significantly negatively related to cost index. For telecommunication and airline industries, production is positively related to private ownership.
