Because category <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sup> firms' expected profit is bigger than that of category <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sup>, therefore, even though consumers think category <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sup> firms is better, it is more likely to become a pressuring target, suffering more corporate social responsibility pressure. When the expected profit coming from the target firms is bigger than the struggling cost needed, both category <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sup> and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sup> firms would choose to fight. Category<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sup> firms adopt the positive PSR signaling strategies, and they send out the signals which can not imitated by the category<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sup> firms, this method can not only make the market disassociate in a balanced and satisfactory, and solve the problems of category<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ω</sup> firms expelling category <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sup> firms, but also can help the category <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</sup> firms create the fine social images, and increase the future profits.

articleTitle: Research of enterprise strategic performance evaluation system based on partial least square-structural equation modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper on the integration of multiple enterprise performance evaluation methods build a new of 5-dimensional 21-index system of performance evaluation model of enterprise, and with PLS structural equation modeling empirical. Result shows that enterprise performance evaluation focused from purely financial index to non-financial index, especially internal employee learning and growth in a modern enterprise performance evaluation of the most important factor. Customer satisfaction degree is also important. Enterprise internal progress influence enterprise strategy more and more, so enterprise should improve the employee quality to be able to make the customer to be pleased, can hold the more market share, can enable the enterprise obtain more profit. In enterprise more new product exploitation and employee worked efficiency improved can bring more income for enterprise.

articleTitle: Board information and board strategic involvement
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The role of boards in firm strategy has long been the subject of debate. Over the last four decades, research on the relationship between boards of directors and strategy has proliferated. Ye t to date there is little theoretical and empirical study regarding the question of how board information affects the boards of directors' strategic involvement. Using a survey data from 104 responses of chairpersons collected in the year of 2010 in China, we examine how board information affects boards' behaviors of strategic involvement. Our study shows that quality of information, information diversity, frequency of board interaction, and proactive seeking information positively influence boards' strategy monitoring and advisory. These findings provide empirical support for agency theory and resource dependence theory on boards.

articleTitle: Work support and turnover intention: The mediating roles of work-to-family conflict and facilitation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Work support is a key construct which has long been suggested to have important effects on turnover intention. This study developed a research model to test the mediating roles of work-to-family conlict and work-to-family facilitation between work support and turnover intention, using conservation of resources theory and social exchange theory. In a sample of 2828 married employees, SEM analysis showed that work-to-family conflict mediated the relation between the work support and turnover intention. Employees who matain the existing resources dealed with work more freely, transfered little tension to family domain and decreased role conflict which led to lower turnover intention. Furthermore, multiple regression analyses were used to test the impact of three sources of work support on work-to-family conflict. The results showed supervisor support most predict reduced work-to-family conflict than colleague support and organizational policies. According to these findings, organization should pay pay more attention to the patterns of leaders and take more care about decreasing employees's pressure instead of offering facilitation.

articleTitle: Empirical research on spatial agglomeration of China's energy industry and the impact factors
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Energy industry is the motive force of economic development. Research on the energy industry in China should not ignore the relativity and the heterogeneity of spatial dimensions. At present, time series analysis is used in most of the energy industry, cross-section data analysis, especially the spatial econometric analysis are rarely applied, this paper takes the mainland provinces and cities in China as spatial samples to analyzes the agglomeration status of energy industry as well as the impact factors with the use of spatial econometrics. Firstly, the location quotient is used to make quantitative measure on the agglomeration of energy industry in 30 provinces of China; secondly, moran index is used to test the spatial dependence of the energy industry agglomeration, finally spatial econometric models are used to analyze the impact factors on the agglomeration of the energy industry, and thus the relevant policies and proposals are put forward. Studies show that the energy industry in different provinces is in uneven development, the agglomeration of energy industry in central regions is higher than that of eastern and western regions, the agglomeration of energy industry is obviously dependent on spatial factors, the industrialization, human capital and fixed assets investment have spillover effect on the agglomeration of energy industry, thus the correlation and heterogeneity of spatial dimension can not be ignored in the research of energy industry agglomeration.

articleTitle: An evaluation on the competitiveness of sci-tech intermediary service industry in Heilongjiang Province based on PCA
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper establishes the evaluation index model to evaluate the competitiveness of sci-tech intermediary service industry in Heilongjiang Province based on Principal Component Analysis(PCA). Totally 16 indicators that can reflect the competitiveness of sci-tech intermediary service industry are set in the index model. By use of PCA, this paper selects three principal components: development environmental factor, industry scale factor, human resource factor. The evaluation result shows that sci-tech intermediary service industry of Heilongjiang Province ranks 14<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> in 31 provinces in China. Considering the problems in the development of sci-tech intermediary service industry, this paper puts forward some suggestions and countermeasures on how to encourage and develop the sci-tech intermediary service industry in Heilongjiang Province, thereby narrowing the gap with the developed regions.

articleTitle: Application of utility management based on article usage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper proposes utility management concept and two standard formulas in library management as application. Consumer preferences made articles to be usefulness and actual data of the effective usage were analyzed the level of spreading article usefulness. Utility function may help articles to be utility and evaluate in current management. The utility management for using the possessive articles in the utility value as the premise of the management, with the effective usage of empirical data to analyze the usefulness of continuing degree of these, and to dug the potential usefulness, to make full use of these, the maximum of use impact and management effectiveness. After goods get out the economy constituent, the action of goods gives expression in the process of utility value in utility management. The book usage factor can evaluate a kind of books within same category and the book usage half-life can evaluate all kinds of books within same category. Two formulas can evaluate different category books in the library collection.

articleTitle: Empirical research on creative human capital of family enterprises: A review based on sustainable development in Yangtze River Delta region of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The article shows how to efficiently introduce creative human capital of family enterprises, resolve the troubles, and disclose its relationship with regional economic sustainable growth. And may find the relationship between regional economic growth and creative human capital is single-directional, the article also have the opinion that, to some extent, creative human capital of family enterprises improves the sustainable development of economic in Yangtze River Delta region of China.

articleTitle: The effects of frame, gender and task difficulty on individual crisis decision-making
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The purpose of the study was to reveal the impact of framing as well as some other relative factors on process of crisis decision. In the study, we recruited 180 undergraduate students and graduate students as participants. A 2(gender) ×2(framing) ×3 (difficulty) experimental design was adapted. Dependent variables are the time participants spent on crisis decision-making, the ratio of creating new viewpoints, the degree of confidence and the degree of the satisfaction during the crisis decision-making process. The results showed that there was the main-effect between framing and the time participants spent on crisis decision-making, ratio of creating new viewpoints participants produced as well as gender and the task difficulties. Meanwhile, the degree of confidence and satisfaction on crisis decision-making was significantly affected by framing types, the task difficulties, and gender.

articleTitle: Risk assessment of offshore engineering equipment projects — A case study of fall pipe vessel in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper presents a scheme for offshore engineering equipment project risk management using a Fuzzy Analytic Hierarchy Process and applies it to fall pipe vessel project in CIMC Raffles (China International Marine Containers Raffles), the largest manufacturer of semi-submersible drilling rig in China. Fifty-eight different risks were deduced from expert interviews, field study and a literature review. A survey analysis was conducted on 73 experts working in CIMC Raffles and other 3 OEE manufacturers in November 2010. The major risks were design risk, joining section risk, welding quality risk, structure error risk as technical risk, and key equipment risk, contract risk, environmental risk, economic exposure, organizing & coordination risk, staff risk, material risk as nontechnical risk in offshore engineering equipment projects. The results of risk sorting and total risk could be used to manage the large engineering project risks and in extending our understanding of offshore engineering equipment project risks.

articleTitle: Electric power consumption and economic growth in China: A panel cointegration analysis and causality test
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In the empirical documents investigating the relationship between energy consumption and economic growth, the existing researches usually use the econometric methods based on the time series and the power of test is worth doubting. In this paper panel cointegration and Granger causality test are adopted to estimate the relationship and source of causation between Chinese electric power consumption, energy price and economic growth. Panel unit root tests support the stationary of these three variables. However panel cointegration does not provide clearer evidences to show the long-run cointegration relationship among variables above. The empirical results also show the elasticity of income against energy consumption is 0.7702 and the elasticity of energy price is 0.2474. Further Granger causality tests and error correction modeling are implemented to show that there exists bi-directional Granger-causality running between energy consumption and economic growth whenever there exists the cointegration or not.

articleTitle: Analysis of entrepreneurship policy for small and medium-sized enterprises in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) have been the foundation for economic development and have provided important contributions to job creation. Support for the SME sector is one of the major planks of government policy in Beijing. Practitioners are seeking to provide a supportive environment for growing ventures. The overall aim of the paper is to deepen the understanding of entrepreneurial policy environment in Beijing. This paper examines the current position of the SME sector in Beijing and develops an evaluation criteria system based on Lundstrom and Stevenson's work for the comprehensive and qualitative analysis of the SME entrepreneurship policy environment. It also includes a critical assessment of the challenges that lay ahead of entrepreneurial policy implementation in Beijing. Policy and managerial implications are put forth at the conclusion of the research and they should be valuable to policy makers, entrepreneurs and managers.

articleTitle: Path analysis on the effect of CEO turnover on enterprise value based on embeddability perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Social network theory suggests CEO embeds in the internal and external networks of enterprise, and his network embeddability decides the amount of social capital what derived from the network structure, which could become the key to create enterprise value. When CEO turnover occurs, the different internal and external enterprise network embeddability of the original and successor CEO leads to the different the amount of social capital, which leads to the change of enterprises value. Take this theory as basis, the regression analysis with intermediary variables is used to test the logical link among CEO turnover, CEO network embeddability and enterprise value, and test the intermediary effect of CEO network embeddability between CEO turnover and enterprise value. The results of empirical analysis validated that the embeddability is the path of the study on the relationship between CEO turnover and enterprise value.

articleTitle: An empirical research study on investment expenditure & cash flow based on growth differences of listed companies: Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Healthy growth of listed companies provides great contribution to the development of economy. How reasonable capital expenditures and cash flows are greatly determines the growth of listed companies, and different growing companies have different levels of capital expenditures and cash flows. In constructing growth evaluation model for listed companies in China, from the aspect of growth, this paper conducts an empirical research on; listed companies' growth and capital expenditures, growth and cash flow, and, the relationship between listed companies' growth and capital expenditures. Major findings from the study show that; regardless of the growth level in Chinese listed companies, capital expenditure has a very significant positive effect on cash flow. Also, capital expenditure and cash flow sensitivity is higher in low-growth companies compared to high-growth companies.

articleTitle: An empirical analysis on government regulatory effect of China's telecommunication industry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper first quantify regulatory degree and regulatory effect of telecommunication industry in China, then establish multiple double logarithmic linear regression equation using time-series data between the year 1992 and 2009 and variables of regulatory degree and regulatory effect. The model is modified by the weighted least squares estimation model after testing its heteroskedasticity and other hypothesis tastings. Under the amended model and final test results, the paper analyzes and evaluates the effect of regulatory reform of China's telecommunications industry, then draws the conclusion: Government regulatory reform has played a positive role in the improvement of overall development, price level and quality of China's telecommunication industry.

articleTitle: Study on the prevention of food safety crisis in China from perspective of the relationships among government, Industry association and enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: We all know that food is essential to maintain life and health for normal metabolic activities can only be ensured by having a plenty of healthful food. But recently, the frequent food safety crises in China, such as dioxin, sudan red, melamine, waste oil, lean meat powder, and staining steamed buns, etc. have involved a wide varieties of food and had strong hazardness, which has made people doubt that "what can we eat now in China?" In view of these frequent crises emerging in food safety, this paper, based on theories of Government Failure and Market Failure, first isllustrates the current situation of China's food safety crisis management, then analyses the causes of crises, and finally proposes that on the basis of strengthening government regulation, non governmental organizations such as food industry associations and consumer organizations should be used to their full potential in prevention of food safety crisis, and fostering corporations' sense of responsibility to prompt government-society-corporation to form a good crisis prevention mechanism and provide our food safety prevention system with some policy advices.

articleTitle: The impact of agglomeration on city technological innovativeness — Empirical study based on the prefecture-level cities' panel data of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The impact of industrial agglomeration externalities on technological innovativeness attracts more and more people's attention. From the perspective of agglomeration externalities, this paper selects 229 prefecture-level cities' panel data of 29 provinces from 2006 to 2008 as samples, calculates the specialization index and diversification index of these cities and analyzes their characteristics. Through theoretical analysis and empirical research this paper studies the interaction mechanism and corresponding contribution of specialization and diversification externalities to cities' technological innovativeness. The results show that: first, for the whole country, the specialized industrial structure has a positive impact on cities' technological innovativeness, the diversified industrial structure negatively affects it; second, for both coastal cities and large cities, the the diversified industrial structure favors city technological innovativeness, for midwestern cities, especially small ones, the specialized industrial structure is conducive to innovation; Third, increasing the investment in education, enhancing the absorption of the international technology spillovers, promoting local economic development are all helpful to technological in-novativeness.

articleTitle: Corporate strategy and environment: Study based on structural equation modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper first analyzes the defect in application of traditional statistical methods to the enterprise strategy in conjunction with their character, and proposes, instead of them, the use of structural equation modeling in the strategic decision making. By comparison, it gets an advantage over traditional statistical approaches like the regression analysis and the factor analysis in many aspects in strategic decision-making analyses. Subsequently, it introduces the theory on the model in detail and highlights some pertinent problems to its application and gives some relevant suggestion. Finally, it illustrates the concrete application through exemplification, through step-by-step analysis of an example, shows how concretely to put it into practice.

articleTitle: Determination of merger premium — Interralationship between corporate, target average and market
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Growth through mergers and acquisitions offers the greatest possibilities to grow quickly compared with organic growth and growth through innovation. But acquirers usually overpay for the target. Some blame it as reasons for long-run underperformance; some even take it as a bad decision. This paper first uses the average target characteristics around M&A announcement date as explanatory variables and premium one week before announcement date as the dependent variable, then the study use the monthly average P/E ratio of targets acquired and market P/E ratio as independent variables, the monthly average premium of targets received as dependent variables and regress on the time series data. The result shows that the monthly average premium of targets received has a negative significantly effect on the monthly average premium received by the targets involved.

articleTitle: The implementation framework and path research of interorganizational cost management in supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Roles that accounting practices need to fulfill in an inter-organizational context are different to the level of a single organization. Interorganizational cost management (IOCM) can be defined as buyers' and suppliers' coordinated efforts to reduce costs. However, today's research of IOCM implementation in supply chain is scattered and inadequate. This paper analyzes IOCM circumstance, techniques, and constructs an application framework of IOCM based on accounting information sharing. After analyzing content and prerequisite of accounting data disclosure, the paper proposes an IOCM implementation framework based on product and relation context. Under product life cycle dimensions, IOCM adopt techniques such as Target costing and kaizen in different production phases. Moreover, the paper analyzes three practices regarding how to implement IOCM under relationship extent dimensions.

articleTitle: Empirical research on regional financial development level of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Regional finance plays a tremendous role in promoting regional economic development. This paper ranks and clusters the regional financial development level of thirty-one provinces and municipalities of China from 2006 to 2008 by using factor and cluster analysis methods. Analysis results show that the difference of regional financial development level not only exists between the east and Midwest, but obviously in every region; comprehensive level of financial development in central region is slightly lower than western region; financial development level of China can be divided into four echelons by region. To narrow the difference of the regional finance development, the paper puts forward some suggestions such as implementing the financial regulation policy differently; putting the regional development policy into practice; carrying out the financial development mode and policy differentially and so on.

articleTitle: Theoretical and empirical research of the relationship between rural labor transfer and rural woodland circulation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper conducts a theoretical analysis of the functional mechanism underlying the influence of rural labor force transfer on woodland element circulation between rural households. Empirical test is also conducted based on econometric calculation and research statistics from rural households of two counties/cities in Zhejiang Province. The result shows: the transfer of rural surplus labor force can promote the restructuring of woodland element between rural households. It can, to some extent, promote the optimization of woodland element and labor force; this paper also finds that the woodland production in China has now a certain degree of scale economy, and woodland is still partially responsible for the livelihood of rural households. This will provide indication for the policy-making in the woodland area.

articleTitle: Factors influencing technological entrepreneurship in Chinese enterprises: Preliminary evidences from Guangdong province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper presents the results of a preliminary empirical investigation undertaken to unveil the factors influencing Chinese enterprises technological entrepreneurship capabilities. Using Pearson correlation and independent-samples t-tests on data collected from 66 Guangdong province technology-based firms during the second half of 2010, the relationship between knowledge management, business model innovation, organizational culture, strong ties, personal relationship and IPR enforcement were investigated. The discussion of the results obtained highlights several possible explications as related to the relevance (or the lack of it) of such factors and identify avenues for further research. The extension to technological entrepreneurship of studies undertaken in related topics, the identification of technological entrepreneurship's role in the Chinese context and its operationalization, are main contribution of this work.

articleTitle: The equilibrium level and dynamic adjustment study of Chinese international exchange reserves from the viewpoint of financial stability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: From the viewpoint of financial stability, this paper sets up the demand model for Chinese international reserves by extending the buffer-stock model of international reserves. The empirical analysis shows that the extended buffer-stock model is applicable to Chinese international reserves. The underlying factor resulting in the growth of reserves is the export-oriented economic development pattern. More FDI and the strengthening of financial deepening will increase the demand for precautionary international reserves. Further, this paper uses the Heaviside function to partition the VECM and finds Chinese international reserves misalignment will move towards its equilibrium level asymmetrically in short term. Moreover, the change of US monetary policy and exchange rate would impact the short-term adjustment process.

articleTitle: Risk assessment on new old-age insurance system in Chinese rural areas based on factor analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The new rural social insurance system has been implemented in pilot areas across China since 2009. To verify the effects and potential risk of the pilot program, we selected seven indicators, used the survey data from twelve Chinese provinces and empirically assessed risk disparity between different regions. It also reflects the score status of three common factors: rural resident factor, system performance factor and external capital factor. The paper hereby holds that we need to link up rural social insurance policies, advance the program according to different regions, rationally plan the responsibility of the Central and local finance for subsidy expenditure in new rural old-age insurance and promote the full coverage of new rural old-age insurance in a step-by-step manner.

articleTitle: Study on the scientific and technological innovation and the competitiveness enhancement of green food industry in Heilongjiang province
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Scientific and technological innovation is now playing a more and more important role in enhancing the competitiveness of industries, which is particularly true to Heilong Jiang province green food industry, for it is characterized by more input of non-labor capital factor to obtain more output. On the basis of the condition of Heilongjiang province green food industry from 2000 to 2009 and from the perspective of scientific and technological innovation and labor capital input, analyses are made on the declining position on the national scale and the backward competitiveness among the similar regions, the main reasons for the problems above are the backwardness of scientific and technological innovation and the shortage of labor capital input, combined with the industrial theory of life circle, by constructing TFP model, conclusions and suggestions are made by investigating the contribution rate of scientific and technological innovation.

articleTitle: The relationship between mission statements and corporate social performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper has investigated the relationship between mission statement and corporate social performance of top 100 state-owed corporate in china. We found that corporate mission statement concern with customers and supplier, products and services, as well as technology and growth factors are significantly associated with the economic responsible performance, while the high frequency of image which concern with the nation, employee, societies and environmental included in mission statement are not significantly associated with social and environmental responsible performance. The result indicate that mission statement concern with image include issues of social and environmental are related to the needs of legitimacy, it is the reaction to the pressure of formal and informal institutions.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis on the dynamic system of dollar-euro exchange rate — A redesigned method based on the nonlinear dynamic systems
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The new method has been taken to describe the dynamic system of U.S. dollar-euro exchange rate and the monetary and credit policy of the Federal Reserve and European Central Bank. The Grove Tubman - Hartman Theorem has been applied to redesign the system of nonlinear differential equations, with data in two periods: December 1999 - October 2005 and November 2005 - January 2010. The law of relationship changes between exchange rate and interest rates has been modeled. The empirical results show that the dynamics of these changes may have seven systems; this is based on the complex structure of the financial system. Research methods used can be applied for the development of program structure and prediction purposes of the international financial systeml.

articleTitle: Mechanism model of the influence on board structure from the control of single blockholder
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In view of the high ownership concentration of Chinese listed companies, large shareholders tend to make use of the high voting rights at general meetings of shareholders to control the general assembly, so that they can control the composition and structure of the board of directors. Therefore, it's inevitable to consider the phenomenon of the existence of large shareholders when studying the board structure of China's listed companies. Basing on the large shareholders' “tunneling” behavior, this paper constructs Mechanism model of the influence on board structure from single blockholder; the study portrays the board structural feature of China's listed company that is under the control of single block-holder. After the model inferential reasoning, the conclusion is that: under the assumptions that there exist large shareholders in companies, if the large shareholders can influence the structure of the board members, for the purpose to invade the company's value, the large shareholders will arrange the board members appointed by themselves as many as possible, and reduce the non-appointed board members by themselves as many as possible. Meanwhile, the stronger the control ability of the company's large shareholders is, the clearer this trend will be.

articleTitle: Tax planning for cross-border M&A of “dual-tax” company
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: When an enterprise cross-border mergers (M&A) and acquisitions, it is bound by two national tax laws at least, and directly affects cost in M&A and benefits after M&A. On the basis of reviewing past literature, after-tax income, M&A costs and income tax credit of both sides of M&A are analyzed in four kinds trading patterns of taxable M&A “dual-tax” company by comparative analysis, and found that taxable stock M&A with no incremental tax base more easily accepted by both sides of M&A. If the target company and its shareholders can make the acquirer pay in fair market value more than the target assets, which can accept taxable asset acquisitions with incremental tax base. If the acquirer can pay under their willing payment price, or the target company had a net operating loss, they are willing to choose taxable asset acquisition with incremental tax base.

articleTitle: FDI and industrial agglomeration based on the perspective of financial developmeaint
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper analyzes not only the relationship between examination of provincial existence of FDI and industrial agglomeration, but also FDI inflows and the financial environment for industrial agglomeration factor. Through model construction and the use of panel threshold regression analysis, we think the degree of financial development level is the clustering key that restrict China's industrial agglomeration, and we use the 2000 to 2010 provincial panel data, combined with inter-provincial of the financial development by building the threshold panel threshold regression model, examine FDI caused industrial agglomeration effects in different regions, test results confirmed there is a big difference FDI impact on industrial agglomeration in China between provincial and regional differences. And on this basis, we further to regression estimates the degree of financial development on the threshold effect of industrial agglomeration effect caused by effects of, empirical results reveal the degree of financial development as important factors in promoting industrial agglomeration, it can effectively play the role of the middle of transmission, and promote industry agglomeration.

articleTitle: Performance evaluation of Chinese Stock Open-end funds based on their unobserved actions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: To measure the unobserved actions of mutual funds, this essay adopts a new variable called the return gap. In this way, we examine the influence of funds' unobserved actions on fund holders. Moreover, based on the unobserved actions, we further modify the Fama-French model and analyze the unobserved actions' determinants, persistence and performance evaluation, through the panel data of 98 Chinese Stock Open-end Funds. Lastly, this essay ends with the conclusions that unobserved actions can reflect decisive fund properties such as interim transaction costs and fund risks, that the actions can better evaluate the fund performance, and that the evaluation of unobserved actions can help fund holders, with higher accuracy, to choose from different funds.

articleTitle: Construction of information system for anti-dumping accounting responding
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: It is fatal for a successful anti-dumping responding to provide accurate and in-time information including responder's cost and market share, competitor's cost and third country's market price. Aiming at severe situation our country currently faces with and from the point of view of combination of information work and anti-dumping accounting, this article tentatively analyzes the types of information demands, information collection methods and processing methods at different market economy status on account of anti-dumping responding in foreign countries; additionally, it also combines the information and actual foreign trade, and constructs a information system for anti-dumping responding; put forwards some tentative proposals on the information collection and processing from such ways as collaboration of enterprises of same sector, response plans for different market economy status, employing excellent experienced lawyers from the anti-dumping claimer country, cooperating with the importers, communicating and coordinating with relevant government. It is expected that these tentative proposals might be some effective references of evading and responding foreign anti-dumping claims for our country's enterprises, so as to improve the anti-dumping responding capacity of enterprises of our country and protect their vital interests.

articleTitle: The analysis on the value drivers of agriculture high-tech companies based on the balanced scorecard
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the principle of Balanced Scorecard, this paper identified key value drivers of agriculture high-tech companies from the aspects of financial, customer, internal operation, innovation and learning. Then, we built the index system for evaluating agriculture high-tech companies' value comprehensively. And we selected 40 listed agricultural high-tech companies from Shenzhen Exchange and Shanghai Exchange range from the year 2007 to 2009. We got 82 the effective samples data and use regression analysis to verify the existence of correlation of mutual influence between certain indicators of key value driver and the value of companies, and make arrangement analysis of value drivers by its impact on enterprises' value. The results show that the key value drivers do have certain correlation with the value of agricultural high-tech companies. The collusion will provide some significant clues for improving the value of agricultural high-tech companies.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between grain production and development of animal husbandry
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Grain production and development of animal husbandry are the keys in agriculture and animal husbandry production, there are relationships between them, such as competitive, symbiotic, alternative, collaboration and cooperative. This paper uses the coordination degree of grain livestock production to make a quantitative analysis for grain production and the development of animal husbandry, based on the case of Heilongjiang province, this paper analyze the coordination degree of grain livestock production changing trends and abhorrent mode in Heilongjiang province from timing and space two aspects. Heilongjiang province is not only an important commodity grain production base in China but also a large production province of national important animal products, the relationship between grain production and the development of animal husbandry in Heilongjiang has important significance of constructing grain base, it has been one of the important problems of research in Heilongjiang province. On the basis of these, we make some suggestions between grain production and development of animal husbandry in Heilongjiang province.

Author Keywords: the coordination degree of grain livestock production

articleTitle: Corporate social responsibility in China's housing market: House-buyers' perspectives
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In recent decades, public awareness of corporate social responsibility (CSR) continues to increase. Today's consumers expect businesses to go beyond their profit agenda, and be socially responsible. The focus of this paper is the house-buyers' perspective of socially responsible housing developments in Xuchang, China. In this current paper, a qualitative approach, by way of house-buyer focus-group, was used to uncover house-buyers' criteria of basic housing development and factors influencing their purchase decisions. In this paper the authors intend to analyse the links between CSR and the consumer behaviour through a survey undertaken in a sample of Xuchangese consumers. In order to validate the survey a structured equations model was applied. Research result showed that most house buyers expect a socially responsible developer to provide more CSR features in their housing projects regardless of the type of property developed. The research hypotheses were mostly confirmed except the influence of identity salience in the behavioral aspects of consumers. Research result showed that most participants expected developers to provide more CSR features in their housing projects regardless of the type of property developed.

articleTitle: Fault-tolerant planning methodology for catastrophe response
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, related research works on catastrophe response methodology are reviewed from perspectives of catastrophe scenario analysis, response preparedness planning, response tasks planning and fault-tolerant design for critical infrastructure. For the need of catastrophe response tasks planning, a conceptual framework of response-preparedness methodology for system modeling and deployment is proposed, which is on the base of interrelated response and preparedness.

articleTitle: Research on growth of professional manager and sustainable development of family enterprise: A review based on trust expansion
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With family enterprise growing, she needs to absorb and integrate new management resource continuously. Family enterprises have unique trust mechanism; In the process of retaining professional managers, there is the absence of some respects of trust mechanism, and ideal and so on. It is effective to introduce pan-family regulation to integrate management resource, expand the trust space of family enterprises and retain multiple competitive systems to restrict professional managers. Consequently, effective fusion of professional managers, trust and family enterprises will come true.

articleTitle: The research on financial monitoring of managers based on dynamic capital structure adjustment
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In agency theory, the debt right and equity ownership of capital structure have the effect of government, which can realize the monitoring of the managers' financial behaviors. In this paper, we use a dynamic multi-agent model to study how to dynamically adjust the capital structure to achieve the target of monitoring the managers' investment, financing and profit sharing behaviors. In the established investment environment, in order to avoid infringing the interests of clients and maximize the enterprise value, each party in agency relationship can reduce the agency costs and achieve capital structure improvement by the game process of dynamic adjustment of capital structure. We also believe that in order to protect the interests of minority shareholders, over-concentration and over-dispersion of equity should be both avoided and diversified ownership structure of investment should be advocated.

articleTitle: Research on the state-owned enterprise operators demand analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The qualitative methods and quantitative methods were used in this study, the state-owned enterprise operators demand characteristics were discussed. Through literature review, the theoretical of the state-owned enterprises operators demand were analysed, by adopting the methods of questionnaire surveys to state-owned enterprise operators. According to the questionnaire survey results, thirty-eight items about operators demand characteristics were extracted, and the original scale was designed. Through exploratory factor analysis and confirmatory factor analysis, a six dimensionality measurement tool of state-owned enterprise operators demands was established, it contains: “achievement demand ", "self value compensation demand" and "respect demand ", "career development demand", "power demand" and "occupational safety demand ". A preliminary exploration was proceed for establish the state-owned enterprise operators demand characteristics model.

articleTitle: The impact of financing motivation on development strategy orientation of entrepreneurial firms
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the theoretical analysis of the relationship among financing motivation, financing choice and development strategy orientation of entrepreneurial firms, this paper puts forward a proposition on the impact of financing motivation on development strategy orientation of entrepreneurial firms, which is then tested empirically using survey data from massive Chinese entrepreneurial firms. The research finds that wealth accumulation motivation and self-determination motivation are two main motivations that influence financing choice of entrepreneurial firms. Driven by the two main financing motivations, entrepreneurial firms primarily choose exogenous equity financing and exogenous debt financing. Financing choice affects development strategy orientation of entrepreneurial firms. Exogenous equity financing leads to entrepreneurial firms' active development strategy orientation while exogenous debt financing leads to their steady development strategy orientation.

articleTitle: Empirical analysis of the relationship between listed companies' ultimate control and corporate performance
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper analyzes the correlation between the indicators of corporate performance and the indicators of the ratio of ultimate control, the control difference, the control levels, the nature of ultimate controlling shareholders and so forth. The results show the corporate performance demonstrates a U-change as the ratio of ultimate control increases; the corporate performance has a negative correlation with control difference of ultimate controlling shareholders; the corporate performance has a positive correlation with the control levels; the corporate performance is poor in companies whose ultimate controlling shareholders are the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council(SASAC), local governments, or the agencies of government etc.; the companies whose ultimate controlling shareholders are natural persons or legal persons have relatively better performance. Based on the conclusions above, related suggestions are proposed respectively for regulators, investors, corporations, and government departments.

articleTitle: Mechanism design of profit distribution for dynamic cooperation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Characteristics of profit distribution for dynamic cooperation have been analyzed from following three aspects: profit that can be distributed, standards for profit distribution and way of how to distribute it. Research has found that proper mechanism of profit distribution can substitute the roles of managerial rules and motivation to some degree and improve the performance of cooperation as well as fruitful outcome. Considering the trait of dynamic cooperation, mechanism of profit distribution which covers the phases of identifying the profit that can be distributed, making principals of distribution and choosing the way of distribution has been proposed. Furthermore, game theory model based on the characteristics of dynamic cooperation has been built to solve the problem of profit distribution in practice.

articleTitle: Study on the development capability evolution of typical settlements of Wenchuan earthquake-stricken areas in Dujiangyan
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Gaoyuan Village of Hongkou Township, Dujiangyan was selected as the typical case of investigation and research. Sampling questionnaire survey was made on the conditions of 60 households in 2004, 2007, 2010. The index system for evaluation of rural settlement development capability in disaster area was established by in combination with the characteristics of the disaster area. The index weight was determined by applying AHP method supported by entropy technology, and typical settlement was evaluated by using fuzzy mathematics method. It was discovered that the disaster prevention capability of the settlement has been greatly improved since 2004, but the development capabilities of people have always been the factor constraining the settlement development. The overall development capability of the settlement has not been changed too much.

articleTitle: Mixed effects of system design for university faculty hiring based on institutional theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Developing a system for attracting world-class talents is a primary step towards building a world-class university. The success of some existing world-class universities proves that developing such a system is the key to retaining a world-class faculty of talents. One of the major problems that have been held accountable for the underdevelopment of China's higher education is that Chinese universities are deprived of their autonomy in decision making in the process of staff hiring and fail to encourage fair competition among applicants. The highly competitive faculty hiring system that American universities employ can be a good example for universities in China to follow in their reform of faculty hiring system. This paper proposes a model of a mixed hiring system, whose positive effects on the endeavor to retain a high-level university faculty have been confirmed by an empirical study, which compared various hiring systems and their organizational performances,. This paper also suggests that universities in China can choose those hiring systems in this model that suit their own specific situations, with a view to increase their comprehensive strength.

articleTitle: Government-launched cluster initiative in developing country: A survey study of modern design industry cluster around Tongji University
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The paper first presents three key analytical frameworks - cluster initiatives and cluster initiative lifecycle - that may be used to explain how cluster initiative affect cluster development. CIs in developed, developing and transition countries are different. In developing and transition countries, cluster initiatives which are donor-initiated CIs are typically centralized to the national level. However, as the biggest developing country, the CIs which happened in China are different. The modern design industry cluster around Tongji University will be planned to be the largest design industry cluster in China. Government-launched cluster initiative in modern design industry cluster around Tongji University is then discussed as a case in point to analyze the process of cluster initiative influencing cluster development in developing country. The paper also made a evaluation of this cluster initiative and some characteristics of Chinese CIs can be found.

articleTitle: The impact of legitimacy on cluster's innovation: Research on innovational investment and performance of STIPs in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper examines the impact of legitimacy of organizational field on cluster's innovation behaviors and performance in China. Through the data of 52 STIPs in China during the period between 2005 and 2007, we find that the presence of innovational legitimacy have a positive effect on the innovational performance of a cluster. Moreover, the legitimacy has a U-style relationship with cluster's R&D HR investment. And the relationship between R&D investment and cluster's innovational performance is be moderated by the legitimacy. These findings indicate that the legitimacy plays a role as both independent variable and moderating variable for the cluster's innovational behaviors. Therefore, it complicates the relationship between innovational performance and innovational behaviors in a cluster.

articleTitle: Competitive strategy, strategic human capital and sustained competitive advantage
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: With economic globalization, facing increasingly fierce competition, more and more companies draw keen focus on how human capital can successfully promote the implementation of firm strategic objectives. Thus, how strategic human capital as corporate strategic resources enables enterprises to gain sustained competitive advantage is getting more and more concerns by more scholars. Based on the resource-based view of the firm and strategic human resource management theory, this paper puts forward the construct of `strategy human capital'. Through the survey of questionnaires responded by human resources managers and general managers in 105 companies in China, it makes an accurate and direct measurement of firms' strategic human capital, and examines the data by hierarchical regression analysis. The results show that the interaction of different human resource management systems and different competitive strategies have different influences on sustained competitive advantage. Meanwhile, different configures of strategic human capital play different intermediary roles in different human resources systems interacting with the competitive strategy on sustained competitive advantage.

articleTitle: The empirical research on regional economic convergence among Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei — From human capital perspective
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Firstly, this paper summarizes the related concepts and models between human capital and regional economic convergence from classical literature. Secondly, it makes some regional economic convergence tests by the convergence model based on the data of Beijing, Tianjin, and Hebei, moreover, it analyzes on the regional economic convergence category and its human capital factor of the three regions. The results indicate that, there is no σ regional economic convergence among Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei since 1978, and absolute β convergence does not exist since 1996. However, there is a strong β conditional convergence when introducting human capital factor, but the club convergence exists neither in Beijing nor Hebei, but a weak club convergence exists in Tianjin. Finally, according to empirical results, the paper puts forward some corresponding proposals for coordinated development of regional economic of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the HMM of nonlinear nominal exchange rates
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The exchange rate model for the study of the exchange rate theory has very important significance. After analyzing the successful nonlinear model of real exchange rate based on the purchasing power parity (PPP) theory, the nonlinear problem of nominal exchange rate is studied in this paper. Through a research on a period of nominal exchange rate with nonlinear characteristics, a nonlinear statistical model of nominal exchange rate based on the hidden Markov model (HMM) is proposed, and the parameters of the model are estimated. Hypothesis testing shows that the model can accurately describe the statistical characteristics of the nominal exchange rate time series. The parameters showed that the nominal exchange rate model proposed in this paper, to some extent, supports that deviations from purchasing power parity (PPP) are nonlinear mean reversions.

articleTitle: A comparative study on NIS (national innovation system) in the Bric economies
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This research characterize and compare the NIS of Brazil, Russia, India and China, pointing out differences and similarities, common bottlenecks and complementarities, as well as identifying current and potential connections. This paper compares several of the key economic parameters and social indicators between the four countries, summarizing a few broader economic and institutional characteristics; examines several of the support system's chief indicators, including production, trade, investment and education; outlines the characteristics of the main players of innovation (including enterprises, research institutes, technology talents and colleges) under three aspects: quantity, structure and innovation efforts; analyzes the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office granted patents and indexed data of the four countries between 1979 and 2006, focusing on innovation performance characteristics - innovation, field and innovative pattern - while attempting to discover what creates differences in performance. Finally, reviews the lessons that may be drawn from this comparison and the evaluation trends of Bric's national innovation systems.

articleTitle: A Research on the motive mechanism of public goods technological innovation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As the rapid development and wide application of science and technology, technological innovation has become not only one of the core ways to enhance the competitiveness of enterprises, but also one of the key means to improve public service level in public fields such as environmental protection, public infrastructure and public health. Obviously, there are not only enterprise technological innovation activities centering on the private goods but also public goods technological innovation activities which serve for the supply of public goods. There are significant differences between enterprise technological innovation and public goods technological innovation. However, the same as enterprise technological innovation, public goods technological innovation is also developed by the behavioral subjects under the motivation of certain motive mechanism. In this paper, the concept of public goods technological innovation is elaborated and the differences between public goods technological innovation and enterprise technological innovation are analyzed, then a brief review on the researches the predecessors have done about the motive mechanism of enterprise technological innovation is given and based on that, the motive factors of public goods technological innovation and its motive mechanism model is discussed. The construction of motive mechanism is of great significance to promote the smooth and effective development of public goods technological innovation, strengthen the capacity building of public goods technological innovation and advance the level of it and the standard of public service.

articleTitle: Analysis of patent pool investment based on option game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Patent pool investment has become an important strategy to enhance the enterprises' competitive power, which should be actively used to protect independent intellectual property rights of the innovation achievements by Chinese enterprises for survival and development in the patent war. The traditional investment decision-making methods ignore the value of management's flexibility and the impact of competitive interaction, so it is limited in measuring the enterprises' patent pool investment with the characteristics of uncertainty, irreversibility and competition. Based on Option Game Theory, this paper sets up the asymmetric duopoly model to analyze the dominant enterprise and the target patent held enterprise's optimal decisions and carries out the balance strategic analysis and numerical analysis to inspect the influence of parameters on the investment option value and investment timing, establishing the general decision-making frame of patent pool investment analysis.

articleTitle: The regional classification of low carbon development and setting the targets of carbon reduction in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: The target that reducing by 17% of carbon dioxide emission per GDP is regarded as constraint indicator into our national economic and social development planning during the twelfth five-year demonstrates the responsible attitude to the global climate change. The article establishes the evaluation system of carbon reduction. Adapted to factor analysis and clusting, it reflects the religion difference of carbon reduction potential and makes the relational classification. Setting targets of carbon reduction in different regions provides theory and method supported for regional targets of carbon reduction.

articleTitle: Research on human resource plan model of medium and small private enterprise based on spanning development strategic — With medium and small private enterprise as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of socialism market economy and private enterprise spanning development, Combining actuality of human resource plan of Chinese private enterprise, This paper respectively to medium and small private enterprise as the research object, discover the problems of human resource plan, analysis the key reason, further more construct human resource plan modeling of private enterprise based on spanning development strategic, probe into effective measure by which modeling can be put into practice successful, summarize method and stratagem of establishing practice and valid evaluation mechanism of enterprise human resource plan. Human resource plan must be a core guarantee for enterprise development, it can improve core competition of Chinese private enterprise on strategic level and offer power human resource for practice of spanning development stratagem.

articleTitle: VAT competition among China's provincial governments and the regulation suggestions
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Since the tax distribution reform implemented in 1994, China has begun general VAT system, and has determined the above as the tax categories shared by both the central government and the local governments. Whereas, “Base Number Technique” sharing is implemented for the VAT revenue between the central and local governments; that is to say, the VAT revenues turned over by the provincial governments are shared by the central and local governments as per the proportion of 75%-25%. The local governments have independent economic benefit, and have strong motivation to perform VAT system, and thereby the VAT revenue increases greatly; however, a new tax competition of VAT is put on the stage. The paper, in the first place, reviews the relevant theories of tax competition, then lists the cross-provincial VAT competition forms in China and analyzes the economic effects caused by VAT competition, and finally, as per the latest theories of the international tax revenue circle, raises some regulation suggestions on the VAT competition behaviors between the provincial governments.

articleTitle: A study on influencing factors and ascensional approaches of organizational learning ability
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Under the tide of globalization, great change has taken place on organizational management environment. The dynamic and complexity of management environment become dominant trend instead of stable operating condition which has become part of history. Proceeding from the current social situation, the author realizes the significance of an organization's ability to keep learning and renew itself; the more learning capacity is owned by organization, the stronger continuous competitive power it has. This paper expounds connotation of organization-learning force. From three aspects consisted by leader, vision and objectives as well as organizational culture, it analyzes factors which influence organizational learning ability and educed three effective approaches as follows: leaders ought to have sufficient level of awareness and draw attention to organizational learning; leaders ought to share business vision together with employees; leaders should strengthen cultural construction of organizational learning ability.

articleTitle: Studies on effects of environmental taxes under perfectly competitive markets — Based on the simulation of China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on the classical model established by De Mooij (2000)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, this paper attempts to investigate the effects of environmental taxes in a small open economy and simulate the results of the model with China's data, so as to propose policy suggestions for China's environmental tax reform. In our model, we suppose the small open economy is under a “second best” framework, where there are pre-distortions (mainly environmental distortions and tax distortions) in the economy. Our study indicates that when the environmental tax reform is carried out on the condition that the revenues of environmental taxes are used to finance distorting taxes, there is a tradeoff between environmental qualities and economic efficiency. Therefore, the effects of “double dividend” fail in our model and simulation on China's data. This also demonstrates that the optimal environmental tax rate under “second-best conditions” is lower than that of Pigouvian tax. However, empirical studies based on China's data indicate that there are great differences between environmental taxes on firms and households. A small environmental tax on households can improve environmental qualities at a very low cost of the economy, but environmental taxes on firms will sacrifice economic growth to a great extent though environmental qualities will be improved greatly.

articleTitle: A study on manager incentive effect based on principal-agent relationship
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Based on existing researches on incentive measures of listed companies, this paper explains the significance of incentive plans for China's listed companies and demonstrates the incentive compensation model as a mature and widely used measure in China to create corporate value. In the empirical analysis, it's found that the proportion of managerial ownership in China is low, indicating that the equity incentive isn't the first choice for listed companies in China. The results of this analysis provide main reference for listed companies in future with equity incentive plans.

articleTitle: Industry specialization, learning effect and audit firms' management model
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Audit firm is an important entity in capital market, and its management model influence its function. According to the development experience of foreign large audit firm and the guidelines of new audit standard in China, our audit firm should implement the industry specialization management model. This study wants to research the relationship between industry specialization of management model and audit quality in China. The empirical result shows: industry specialization not only has positive influence for audit quality in China's capital market, but also, interestingly, the industry specialization implemented by China's audit firm has a “very fast” learning effect, which can improve the audit quality more effectively. We believe that this study provide the empirical evidence for the future management model of our audit firm and the future policy of regulator in China.

articleTitle: Power game and mathematical model improvement of urban public works evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: As an important tool of urban public works evaluation and a result of redistribution of public interests and private interests after power game between each evaluating subject of urban public works, it focus on comprehensive evaluation of urban public works benefits. Owing to complicated relations of each evaluating subject' interests of urban public works and unequal power positions of each subject, a game between groups of high power positions and that of low power positions occurs and results in distorting behavior of urban public works evaluation so that urban public works supply is lacked or excess meanwhile urban public interest is eroded. This paper suggests that some institutional evaluating indexes should be added into the current normal indexes of urban public works evaluation from the perspective of game theory; and points out that mathematical evaluating model of urban public works could be improved based on those new evaluating indexes, consequently, bias conclusion of urban public works evaluation caused by the power game could be corrected. The innovation of this paper is that it attempts to evaluating urban public works from the perspective of power game theory, and then to design some new evaluating indicators of evaluating institutions of urban public works, and finally to establish a better mathematical evaluation model.

articleTitle: The analysis of inter-specific relationships and stability based on the creative value creation ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper constructs creative value creation system with five main value-creating populations - developer, producer, consumer, marketer and intermediary combining with iphone case study. Based on logistic growth model and Lotka-Volterra equations, we discuss their inter-specific relationships - mutualism, collaboration, commensalism and predation. Then we analyze the interactive power between different populations and correspondingly conclude the stability ranges and policy implications.

articleTitle: Research on improvement of Chinese portfolio quality based on random matrix theory
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, from the perspective of prediction of future optimal portfolio, a method for evaluating investment portfolio quality is proposed. Based on the definition of portfolio quality, after making assumptions on the `true' correlation matrix, we theoretically analyze adverse influence of correlation noise on portfolio quality. The method from random matrix theory (RMT) can be used for denoising the correlation matrix in such a way that only statistically relevant information is used. Theoretically portfolio quality can be improved by noise filtering of correlation matrix based on RMT which is empirically proved in many different stock markets. Despite the fact that much noise exists for correlation matrices of Chinese stock returns, whether better portfolios can be achieved from Chinese stock market by application of RMT for removing the noise of correlation matrices is seldom studied. We apply the method based on random matrix theory to cleaning correlation matrices of 102 Chinese stocks and on this basis construct portfolios. Comparison of portfolios with different number of eigenvalues kept in correlation matrices of two different estimation periods shows that the denoising technique from RMT is an effective method of improving portfolio quality in Chinese stock market by successfully cleaning the correlation matrix.

articleTitle: Research on asymmetric trust evolution in the Complex Products and Systems cooperative innovation network
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Inter-organizational trust has been paid great attention by managers for its important role played in the Complex Products and Systems (CoPS) cooperative innovation network. The characteristics of dynamics of trust mechanism and competition and cooperation among members in CoPS cooperative innovation network are analyzed. The trust generation and evolution mechanism in CoPS cooperative innovation network is proposed from the perspective of asymmetric trust by using evolutionary game theory. Results show that trust between members in CoPS cooperative innovation network is asymmetric most of the time during the evolution process. The long-term evolutionary equilibrium structure may be mutual trust among members in CoPS cooperative innovation network, and may not trust each other. The path which trust evolves along and the state it will reach are closely related to the payoff matrix and the game's initial state. Trust in CoPS cooperative innovation network evolves through the dynamic process of development, maintenance, and repair of violation. Trust repair strategy is discussed. Complex network organization management theory can be enriched and trust relationship management ability in CoPS cooperative innovation network can be enhanced with the research.

articleTitle: Forest land contracted management of circulation in the different types peasant household decision — Making behavior analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: This paper constructs the total expected profit function basis, respectively of different types of peasant households of forest land circulation decision-making behavior for analysis, it is concluded that professional farmers tend to inflows decision-making, mainly by agriculture business concurrently with the inflows and outflows of dual tendency, supplemented by agriculture and operators tend to outflow decision-making. In Liaoning 409 so peasant households, for example the empirical analysis, Professional farmers tend to choose woodland inflows, And I and concurrently II business operators tend to not conducted forest land circulation, Facing the theory and the empirical research contradictory. And from the Angle of restricting factors of production obtain, different types of peasant household forest land circulation the decision-making behavior of factors were analyzed. Put forward corresponding policy recommendations on this basis.

articleTitle: Analysis on urban-rural land displacement mechanism based on sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: Sustainable development of the rural areas is the coordinated development strategy of all the main elements of population, resources, ecology, environment, industry and economics, which needs a stable and sustainable capital input and agricultural output, and the input and output target is the most basic means of production - land. Sustainable development of rural areas depends on the strategy of rational land distribution and agricultural industry layout. The use of land is the essential element, and land is the core element of the various development elements. Under the reasonable institution arrangements and the policies guidance, urban-rural land displacement makes use of the price difference to supply the scarcity funds for rural development, protect farmers not to lose their land, improve their living standards, also promote the improvement of rural infrastructure public service system, intensive operate agricultural industries, and provide continuous power for rural development.

articleTitle: Study on the characteristics of motherland distribution of foreign partner of joint venture in China
publicationTitle: 2011 International Conference on Management Science & Engineering 18th Annual Conference Proceedings
abstract: In this paper, we collected and analyzed the correlated data of 11,562 joint ventures all over the China since 1979. The research results we found are as follows: Firstly, the culture distance between different nations could affects on the choice of foreign partners to some extend. The similar background of east culture urges more enterprises from Asia area cooperate with companies from China. There are 7,111 from Asia in all research samples, account for 61.5%. Besides, the influence of culture on the joint venture is different during the different period of economic developing. In the early, the culture has an important effect on the joint venture which belong to high labor demanding industries, but in the upper phase, the technology resources has more significant influence than the culture on those from high technology demanding industries. Secondly, the 6 joint venture earlier created in 1979, the foreign partners are all from HK; At last, during the first stage of joint venture developing, there are 3,376 foreign partners from Asia area of 3,707 piece of samples, account for 83.61%. In the end, we put forward several of proposals on the basis of the problems we found during the process of researching.
